verification.notes: INSTRUCTION-BASED (N3). Antigravity has no session-start event: an always-on workspace rule tells the agent to run the session service in its first answer, and /gtt runs it explicitly. Delivery depends on the agent obeying the rule; never observed in a real Antigravity session.

limitations: No session-start event: the next action reaches the agent only if it follows the always-on rule (or the user runs /gtt).
Whether the always-on rule is loaded in every Antigravity surface (IDE, CLI, desktop) was not observed.
Adapter files are governance machinery: a change goes through the Solution Designer.
